infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Taal Eat uses your location to show nearby restaurants, display accurate delivery distances, and suggest the most relevant food options available in your area.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Taal Eat uses your camera to let you take photos of your food orders and update your profile picture.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Taal Eat uses your photo library to let you choose an existing photo when updating your profile picture or sharing food content.

plugins.contactsPermission: The app needs access to your contacts so you can find friends
